figures.before: Custom vs. Production: What You're Actually Buying
figures.alt: Coastal Florida custom home under framing on an elevated foundation with roof trusses and a graded sandy lot
figures.caption: A custom home provides more control over site response, structure, layout, materials, systems, and the way the finished home supports daily life.

figures.alt: Coastal residential lot with survey stakes, string lines, graded house footprint, and mature vegetation
figures.caption: Site selection should account for drainage, access, setbacks, utilities, soil, flood exposure, vegetation, and the intended house footprint.

figures.caption: Pre-construction connects design decisions to permitting, pricing, long-lead materials, scheduling, procurement, and buildability.
